_comment_1: Copy this file to config.local.json and fill in your own values. config.local.json is git-ignored and will override this template at runtime.
_comment_2: SmartThings OAuth credentials: create an app in the SmartThings Developer Workspace to obtain these.
CLIENT_ID: Please enter your SmartThings CLIENT_ID here
CLIENT_SECRET: Please enter your SmartThings CLIENT_SECRET here
PAT_TOKEN: Please enter your SmartThings Personal Access Token here
LOG_FILE: Please enter the absolute path for the log file, e.g. D:/smartthings_data/logs/smartthings.log
TOKEN_FILE: Please enter the absolute path for the OAuth token file, e.g. D:/smartthings_data/tokens/oauth_token.json
CSV_BASE_DIR: Please enter the base directory for CSV output, e.g. D:/smartthings_data/csv_data
METADATA_FILE: Please enter the absolute path for device metadata, e.g. D:/smartthings_data/metadata/device_metadata.json
BAN_LIST_FILE: Please enter the absolute path for the ban list, e.g. D:/smartthings_data/ban_list.json
CLIP_DIR: Please enter the base directory for camera clips, e.g. D:/smartthings_data/clips
_comment_3: Shelly plugs are polled directly over the local network, so each one needs its own address. Replace the entries below with your own devices; 'label' becomes the CSV file prefix and 'id' is the device identifier reported by the plug.

SHELLY_DEVICES.label: SMP01
SHELLY_DEVICES.ip: Please enter the device IP, e.g. 192.168.0.10
